---

---

### ✅ **Conclusion:**
Yes, **you should be able to spot the Moon** from your location in Edinburgh at this time. It's rising in the northeast, just above the horizon, and will be clearly visible in nautical twilight. If you look toward the northeast shortly after sunset, you should see a bright, nearly full Moon.
